name: rivalis
description: Rivalis — peer-to-peer skill gaming platform prototype (DEMO MODE: simulated funds only)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node -e "require('fs').existsSync('backend/.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env')"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test -- --watch=false
